heading: One system. Two speakers. One cable.
lede: Elevate Duo is a pair. The active speaker holds the amplifier, the Bluetooth and the crossover. The passive speaker takes its signal from the active one through the cable supplied in the box. Only the active speaker needs power.
image_alt: Two ceiling speakers set flush into a curved plaster ceiling, one on the left and one further along to the right, with an arched window in the corner below.

passive.title: Passive speaker
passive.text: Receives its signal from the active speaker.
